// Diagnostics and coverage.
M:System.Diagnostics.StackFrame.GetMethod;Use DiagnosticMethodInfo.Create(StackFrame)
// Microsoft code coverage also skips [DebuggerNonUserCode], [DebuggerHidden] and [CompilerGenerated] code by default,
// so those are coverage exclusions too. [GeneratedCode] cannot be banned here (STJ source-generator output carries it,
// RS0030 would fire on it); ExclusionGate checks it instead: no [GeneratedCode] type or method of a src/ Release assembly
// with code outside *.g.cs (read from metadata), and no committed *.g.cs under src/ (the coverage settings exclude
// **/*.g.cs by path).
T:System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute;No coverage exclusions (ADR-0037)
T:System.Diagnostics.DebuggerNonUserCodeAttribute;No coverage exclusions (ADR-0037)
T:System.Diagnostics.DebuggerHiddenAttribute;No coverage exclusions (ADR-0037)
T:System.Runtime.CompilerServices.CompilerGeneratedAttribute;No coverage exclusions (ADR-0037)
